scientific_integrity: Original-time analytic asymptotics on the strict positive-coefficient cubic global-center family; quantitative period/turning-gap results for the same system are acknowledged as known, not asserted as discoveries. Proof of new unbounded-moment statements and uniform moment-window is supplied. No independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive alpha,beta; fixed moment orders or locally uniform crossover parameter; not uniform on parameter boundaries.
Previously known same-system period and turning-gap laws are supporting context, not a new contribution.
Unindexed literature and unreported consequences of earlier turning-gap analyses may affect publication priority.
Finite computational tests do not replace the infinite asymptotic proofs.
title: Critical-window crossover and exponential velocity moments in a cubic global center
